task_a: Preserve original header casing when exposing Headers.keys().
task_b: Optimize Headers.update by removing existing entries through direct normalized-key matching.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A makes Headers.keys() expose original-case header names. Patch B optimizes Headers.update() by directly comparing incoming keys against normalized lookup keys. Together, an update with different casing fails to remove the old logical header and leaves duplicate values in the internal header list.
notes: First state-invariant seed. It captures the invariant that Headers.update must leave one logical value per updated header regardless of presentation casing.
